thought.text: **AntiAwsWaf berhasil di Amazon** — dan solusinya kaya: `token`, `cookie`, `captchaVoucher`, `userAgent`. Ini penting. Sekarang tes CaptchaFox dengan sitekey asli dari GMX.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" "https://signup.gmx.com/" -o /tmp/gmx.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; echo "=== cari sitekey CaptchaFox ==="; grep -oiE 'sk_[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|captchafox[^"'"'"' ]{0,40}|data-sitekey="[^"]+"' /tmp/gmx.html | sort -u | head -10

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A \"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36\" \"https://signup.gmx.com/\" -o /tmp/gmx.html -w \"HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n\"; echo \"=== cari sitekey CaptchaFox ===\"; grep -oiE 'sk_[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|captchafox[^\"'\"'\"' ]{0,40}|data-sitekey=\"[^\"]+\"' /tmp/gmx.html | sort -u | head -10", "summary": "Find real CaptchaFox sitekey on GMX signup", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}

summary: Find real CaptchaFox sitekey on GMX signup
